desc:
You work as M.E.G. employees who are charged with the duty to enter levels of The Backrooms and complete missions given to you. from guiding a lost traveler to closing No-clip zones. Seems easy right! right?

⚠️WARNING⚠️
This game is in Alpha and may have bugs

For the best experience:
🔊  Turn up your volume 
📈 Turn on max graphics

🖥️Supports:
PC, Mobile, and Console

👍 Like, Follow, and Favorite the game it really helps

🌐Join the Group and The Community Server!

Inspired by The Backrooms Wiki and Lethal Company
